description: This file implements HTTPS connection handling and special features for curl, including connection states, think of it as a core part of the HTTPS connection lifecycle management in curl, with specific handling for HTTP/2, HTTP/3, and QUIC.

classes.name: struct cf_hc_baller
classes.description: Represents a connection filter for handling specific connection attempts or protocols such as HTTP/3 or HTTP/2.

classes.name: struct cf_hc_ctx
classes.description: Context structure maintaining the state of the HTTPS connection process, including collision with HTTP/2, HTTP/3, and timeout settings.

methods.name: void cf_hc_baller_reset(struct cf_hc_baller * b,struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Resets the state of a cf_hc_baller instance, closing and discarding its connection filter chain.

methods.name: bool cf_hc_baller_is_active(struct cf_hc_baller * b)
methods.description: Checks if a cf_hc_baller is active (enabled, has a connection filter, and no error result).

methods.name: bool cf_hc_baller_has_started(struct cf_hc_baller * b)
methods.description: Checks if a cf_hc_baller has begun its connection process.

methods.name: int cf_hc_baller_reply_ms(struct cf_hc_baller * b,struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Queries the reply time in milliseconds for a given connection filter baller.

methods.name: bool cf_hc_baller_data_pending(struct cf_hc_baller * b,const struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Checks whether a baller has pending data to be read.

methods.name: void cf_hc_baller_init(struct cf_hc_baller * b,struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,const char * name,int transport)
methods.description: Initializes a connection filter baller with a specific connection filter and configuration.

methods.name: CURLcode cf_hc_baller_connect(struct cf_hc_baller * b,struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,bool * done)
methods.description: Attempts to establish a connection using the baller, updating its state accordingly.

methods.name: void cf_hc_reset(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Resets the entire connection filter context, including both ballers and state indicators.

methods.name: CURLcode baller_connected(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_hc_baller * winner)
methods.description: Handles the successful connection scenario, switching the protocol based on negotiated ALPN and updating the connection state.

methods.name: bool time_to_start_h21(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct curltime now)
methods.description: Determines whether to start an HTTP/2 connection based on elapsed time, timeout settings, and whether the HTTP/3 connection is active.

methods.name: CURLcode cf_hc_connect(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,bool blocking,bool * done)
methods.description: Main state machine to progress through connection setup, handling protocol switching between HTTP/3, HTTP/2, and HTTP/1.x.

methods.name: void cf_hc_adjust_pollset(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct easy_pollset * ps)
methods.description: Adjusts the pollset (I/O multiplexing) based on connection readiness and pending data.

methods.name: bool cf_hc_data_pending(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,const struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Checks if there is pending data to read on either protocol connection filter.

methods.name: struct:curltime cf_get_max_baller_time(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,int query)
methods.description: Queries the maximum of the scheduled times for connection ballers (HTTP/2 and HTTP/3) to determine optimal timing.

methods.name: CURLcode cf_hc_query(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,int query,int * pres1,void * pres2)
methods.description: Handles informational queries about connection timing and status.

methods.name: void cf_hc_close(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Closes and cleans up connection filters and resets context.

methods.name: void cf_hc_destroy(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Frees and destroys the context structure.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_cf_https_setup(struct Curl_easy * data,struct connectdata * conn,int sockindex,const struct Curl_dns_entry * remotehost)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: CURLcode cf_hc_create(struct Curl_cfilter ** pcf,struct Curl_easy * data,const struct Curl_dns_entry * remotehost,bool try_h3,bool try_h21)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: CURLcode cf_http_connect_add(struct Curl_easy * data,struct connectdata * conn,int sockindex,const struct Curl_dns_entry * remotehost,bool try_h3,bool try_h21)
methods.description: unavailable
